approved_scope: Bounded Section 12 companion to M1; independent of browser/headless acceptance. No replacement native client or external game account.

bounds.stop: Stop on a complete real-runtime demonstration or exhaustion of the architecture/live-attempt bound. Diagnostic-only preflight checks never establish compatibility. A resource/time bound is not proof of impossibility.

pinned_source.source_capture_helpers: tools/source-capture (read-only reuse; offline evidence is not live evidence)

architectures.name: Unmodified runtime with a composition-root protocol adapter
architectures.hypothesis: An unchanged native client, official RuneLite Guice module, ClientUI, plugin lifecycle, EventBus and XP Tracker can be composed around generated ClubScape protobuf transport. Original scene/player rendering can consume committed authoritative projections without running the unrelated OSRS network/login pump.
architectures.falsification: The official client/scene or plugin requires an unavailable native lifecycle invariant that cannot be supplied by a narrow state/render adapter; or the real server event cannot be linked to native state and the named plugin without fabricating authoritative state.
diagnostics: Original init revision and exact artifact hashes
Official ClientUI and plugin class identity/lifecycle
Committed HTTP/protobuf receipt, revision/tick, typed player position and XP
Native scene tile/object counts, native penguin model/position and real canvas pixels
Deduplicated server event to StatChanged to XP Tracker observable result
architectures.status: implemented; original-runtime offline preflight passed; live tuple unverified

architectures.name: Focused original-runtime lifecycle interception
architectures.hypothesis: If composition fails specifically on startup or callback ownership, a narrowly pinned lifecycle interception can keep RuneLite's original entry/lifecycle while replacing only OSRS transport/tick entry points with ClubScape adapter scheduling.
architectures.falsification: Required interception expands into a replacement client or inseparable OSRS protocol/game-rule emulation, or the remaining bounded live attempts still cannot establish the complete tuple.
diagnostics: Exact modified classes/methods and original hashes
Original lifecycle versus adapter scheduling ownership
Same end-to-end live scene/player/event/plugin assertions as A
architectures.status: not executed; client lifecycle interception cannot solve reproduced shared service prerequisites

required_together: Original RuneLite runtime and genuine XP Tracker launch
Actual loopback authoritative ClubScape service with isolated PostgreSQL and fresh ClubScape signup/login
Source slice scene and source penguin player rendered live by the original renderer
Live authoritative state and events reflected in client state
Legitimate in-scope XP-producing action reflected in the genuine generic plugin
not_sufficient: Offline source fixtures or PNG viewport
Seeded progression, XP, items, faster ticks or weakened engine guards
